events.title: We're Looking for Playtesters!
events.summary: Unfortunate Souls Wanted!We're looking for opinionated individuals to participate in Gloom Punk's first playtest! 📆 24th June-7th August (Don't worry, you can join at any point during this period!)You'll be testing an extended version of the game, so for those who've checked out the demo already, you'll get to see beyond much more beyond that! We'll be hosting sign-ups and onboarding on Firstlook, so check out this link: https://gloompunks.firstlook.gg/ and we'll have you set up ASAP!

events.title: The Punks' First Trip To PAX!
events.summary: Watch out Boston, Punks headed your way!We're dragging some of our unlucky Punks to the showfloor of PAX EAST 2026! From 26th-29th March, join these miserable souls on their trek through a bite-sized Khorasan experience!📆 26th-29th March📍Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center🎮 Booth 15084If you're not headed down to PAX, no worries, we're making Gloom-scrolling accessible to everyone! An online demo will also be available on Steam throughout the weekend.
